confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live listings or menus checked. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately confident because Nadi's food and drink price points are fairly well known. Accommodation anchors are less certain, especially the 3-star and hostel private room, since Nadi's range runs from basic guesthouses to large resorts. July is treated as a normal (not off-season) month, so accommodation anchors are typical paid rates including taxes and mandatory fees. Beer, coffee, cocktail, and wine are estimated from general regional pricing relationships rather than direct observation, with wine and cocktail set slightly above beer. Overall the anchors are plausible to within roughly ±25%. The FX observation was taken from search-result reporting of the RBA 15 October 2026 figure and was not confirmed by opening the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Pacific island tourism hubs, mainly Port Vila (Vanuatu) and Apia (Samoa), adjusted for Nadi's gateway role and the price premium of the Denarau and Nadi resort belt relative to the town centre. Fijian dollar-to-USD conversion is embedded in these estimates.
